title: cytisus tridentatus
intro: Cytisus tridentatus, commonly known as 'Three-toothed Broom', is a flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various folk remedies, with reported health benefits including its potential to reduce fever and alleviate gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus tridentatus are primarily attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and astringent, which may help to soothe and protect mucous membranes. Bioactive constituents of the plant include isoflavones, alkaloids, and flavonoids, although further research is necessary to fully understand their effects on human health.
